description: The Nitramax Bluetooth 5.4 Wireless Neckband Headphones are designed for those who demand both performance and comfort in their everyday audio experience. Equipped with the latest Bluetooth 5.4 technology, these headphones offer seamless and effortless pairing with your devices, ensuring a stable and uninterrupted wireless connection. Enjoy up to 20 hours of continuous playtime on a single charge, making them ideal for long commutes, workouts, and extended listening sessions. The superior bass output delivers rich, immersive sound quality that brings your music to life. Intelligent Voice Noise Reduction technology ensures crystal clear calls even in noisy environments, so you never miss an important conversation. The ergonomic sports earbud design sits comfortably around your neck and stays securely in place during physical activity. Available in a sleek black finish, these neckband headphones combine style with functionality. Whether you are hitting the gym, going for a run, or simply relaxing at home, the Nitramax Neckband Headphones are your perfect audio companion.
